reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Atropos (https://atroposjs.com/).
Technology stack: javascript, css, react, web-components.
Component specification: 最后看 React 的 <Atropos> 用法。

Visual details from source observation: 首页紫底山景卡写 ATROPOS JS，版本 v2.0.2。文档从 npm i atropos 讲起。React 页 Component Usage 给出 import Atropos from 'atropos/react' 与 <Atropos className="my-atropos">。页脚 MIT。适合做触摸友好的 3D 卡片。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
